title: Software Engineer - Full Stack Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Software Engineer - Full Stack.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Entry-level / New Grad: Clean API integration, full-stack data flow from DB to UI, basic responsive styling, and basic SQL/NoSQL operations.
2. Mid-level: End-to-end feature architecture, REST/GraphQL API design, relational data modeling, client state hydration, and authentication/authorization.
3. Senior: Distributed full-stack architecture, full-stack performance tuning, server-driven UI, caching across CDN/Redis/Browser, and automated full-stack test automation (unit/integration/E2E).
4. Staff-plus: Technical strategy bridging client user experience with scalable backend microservices, unified telemetry, and system-wide reliability.

sections.heading: Question Strategy & Guidance
lines: - PREFER BRIEF PILLARS: Prioritize the candidate's full-stack stack and named projects in the interview brief.
- Explore the seams between client and server: network latency, payload serialization, optimistic UI updates, and error boundary handling.

sections.heading: Interview Type Adaptation
lines: - system-design: Design end-to-end systems spanning client apps, API gateways, database schemas, and background job queues.
- domain-role: Focus on full-stack patterns (Next.js/React + Node/Go/Python/Postgres), schema migrations, and security.
